rationale: Author's name, verbatim from line 6605. One flat noAim serve at vx face*(13+c*4), vy only -3: racket pock, then a departing whistle.

AUTHOR NAME RESTORED: the header 'Toxic Wave: a big lobbed poison glob that splatters' sits directly above barf(), and describes this grav+bounce+poison lob exactly, not Barf Bag's pool. Retch up, wet splat down.

Renamed from 'Acid Bloom' (collided with Fern's Full Bloom). Code erupts an acid pool r=70+c*40, burns everyone in it, then leaves a life-200 poison+slow puddle: a wet outward burp settling into a hiss.

Author's name. Three simultaneous beam lines (#ff2a4a core plus wings at y±12) 960px across: core sweeps up, two staggered fan harmonics, hiss that OPENS. Core dropped 880->740 to ease the weight inversion vs lighter fighters.
Author's name (kept despite sharing a word with Coiny's authored Slap Cyclone). Sweeps a 220x80 box, sets onground=false, expels everyone. Lead saw lifted 200->240 to clear Basketball's 170 engine.
Author's name. f.vy=13 plunge, hitCircle BELOW her at f.y+f.r launching -11-c*3: pitch drops fast, dark thump (w46, fluff not stone), rising triangle for the foe popping up.
Author's name. vx=face*26 with 12 puffs trailing BEHIND her: saw sweep up for the acceleration, quieter delayed twin for the afterimage, wind opening past the ear.
Author's name. Pure stance, no hitbox. Raised 880->1180 to break a head-on collision with Gaty's Mirror Field (both opened on an 880 triangle rising) and to put w59 Needle above w101 Gaty.
Author's name. reflecting=50+c*24 plus an outward shove; the only entry with no noise layer, which is what a pure mirror should be. Dropped 880->620 for the same collision fix, correct for w101.
Author's name. Pure radial shockwave, no projectile, no travel: a real bell spectrum, low fundamental under an inharmonic ~2.4x partial, all drifting flat as they decay, over a 30ms clapper.

Author's name. One heavy hitCircle then defined=600 and 3 stacks: cover slam, spine crack, pages clapping shut (noise bright->dull), 660 tick as the tag stamps on. Sub lifted 150->176 to clear Flower's crusher.

Author's name. One bounce:true projectile with accel:true, a heavy ball that gets FASTER: leather slap, deep bounce, then a saw climbing 170->520 which is the acceleration itself, capped by a rim rattle.
Author's name. Only 8+c*7 damage and kb 4 but hitstun 36+c*20 in a forward cone: an ad blare, not a hit, so a two-note square jingle over a sub that carries the wavefront.
Author's name. boomerang:true with boomCurve 0.22 and homeX literally goes out and comes back, so the two tones are mirrored sweeps: up on the throw, down on the return.

Author's name. Charge at 12+c*5 with armor and a hitCircle ahead: throttle opening under a square harmonic, noise opening into blade chatter. Pitched up 110->140 because w62 must not sit at w99 Saw's fundamental.
Author's name. Grabs the nearest foe inside 140 and hits with kb x=0, y=-16-c*5: pure vertical carry, so everything rises and the noise OPENS. Lightest fighter here, so the highest and airiest.

3-hop loop re-seeding src=tgt and subtracting n*1.2 damage: three blips falling in pitch AND gain. Lifted to 2200/1750/1400 so the lightest fighter (w54) tops the roster and clears Naily's nail burst.
Four burn:true projectiles fanned across vy [-5,-2.5,0,2.5]: literally a match being struck. Scrape noise closing, ignition snap, then a saw flaring UP as the burning shots fan out.

Not a hit at all: vx face*(9+c*4) plus _sawing 40+c*20 and armor 20, re-hitting every 6 frames. Motor winding up under a sustained metallic blade shriek. This is the canonical grinder; Donut's glaze is deliberately its softer cousin.

Renamed from 'Triple Splat' (near-duplicate of Toothpaste's Triple Squeeze, and it echoed her own special Salsa Splat). for(const dx of [5,7,9]) throws exactly three lobbed globs, each landsPuddle: three staggered descending blips over a wet spray.

Renamed from 'Fivepenny Fan' (too obscure to read in play). Five van:true piercing nails at 13+c*3 with kb:0 punch through rather than launch: three pings spaced only 35ms apart read as automatic fire, tightened and dropped clear of Lightning's chain.

One grav-free candy shot with root:true; kb is only 4, so it pins rather than launches. Fast thwip, then everything collapses and the gluey filter clamps shut. Collapse dropped 300->240 to clear Marker's ink splat.

Radius swells with charge (90+c*50) and pins everyone at hitstun 40, the longest lockdown here, then 22 CRT-blue puffs. Mains buzz raised 120->132 and the hum 60->78 so w117 TV sits above w120 Bomby and w138 Tree.

Renamed from 'Reverse Polarity' (reads as sci-fi, not object show). One grav:false bolt whose whole payload is reverseCtrl:true, so the sound mirrors itself: a sweep up immediately answered by the same sweep down. Dropped 300->260 to clear Bracelety's boomerang.
Pops foes at vy -13-c*3 in a ring of f.r+90 AND recoils Pillow herself via f.vy=min(f.vy,-6): a two-way spring. Muffled whump under a boing sweeping up, noise filtered dull like fabric.
armor 30+c*14 plus _empower=1 plus twelve puffs around himself: a self-aura first, a palm second. Retuned off 392 (Bell's fundamental) to 336/504/672 so the two never share a pitch class.

Takes no charge argument, has no hitbox, hits nobody: only f.cloud=720 and pale mist. The one smash that does nothing to anyone, so it is the quietest entry in the game. Shifted to 480/720 to clear Bubble's 420/700.

No hitbox at all: f.curse=190 and f.spCd=150, a five-second aura bought with her own special. No impact transient anywhere; it powers on and sinks, one late glint, wash smothering shut. Colour lifted #8b5cf6->#a78bfa for dark-stage legibility.

Author's name. Wide hitCircle (r+40) that also sets burn=120 on a larger radius: gassy fwoomp, strike-spark, noise flaring bright then rolling DOWN to a roar, low triangle as the burn settles. Opposite in both axes to Firey Jr.'s flare.

Author's name. Only hits foes with t.onground within 150px, launching them straight up at -14-c*4, puffs scattered 260 wide. Deep stomp, long quake rumble, wide dark scatter, one rising sine for the vertical pop. Rumble lifted 95->108 to stay above w116 Sidewalky.
Author's name. Radius 110+c*40 radial with distance falloff and f.pct+=10 self-damage on a w120 body: the deepest sub in the game, a sawtooth crack, and debris collapsing from 5000Hz to 200Hz.

Author's name. dropProj drops one r:20 weight from above onto feetY. Rebuilt to break a near-identical collision with Blocky's anvil (both were a 700Hz whistle into a 150Hz square with the same 700->160 noise): Flower is now blunt mass, a fatter falling whistle into a SINE crater with a wide dust cloud, and no metal ring.

Author's name. dropProjs seven telegraphed pins along x+face*(30+i*44), so the sound is two-stage like the telegraph: a whistle falling for the descent, then two tinks as the row lands, noise opening 3000->6000 as they scatter down the line.

Author's name. dropProjs a r=16 #3a3a3a weight onto the nearest foe from above. Retuned away from Flower's crusher: higher, thinner whistle, a SQUARE iron impact rather than a sine one, a bright 2100 ring only he has, and a short hard noise instead of a dust cloud. Colour moved off the near-white cluster to slate.

Author's name. Low knockback (kb 4+c*4, vy -5) with jittered puffs and a /Firey|Bomby/ check for 14 instead of 9: a flurry, not a launcher. Each tap now cracks DOWN while the series steps up, and the whole thing was lifted clear of Yellow Face's rising jingle.

Author's name, from the inline comment on line 6718. The header above it ('Cap Barrage: fan of three caps') is stale: the code spawns ONE projectile, van:true + boomerang:true + boomCurve 0.20, which is exactly what 'Power Cap: piercing boomerang with 2x range' describes. Click, saw falling away, same saw rising back.

Author's name. Aborts unless f.onground, then launches a grav-false r:20 van from feetY at vx face*13 that drives AWAY. Reversed from a rev-up to a departure so it stops colliding with Saw, Donut and Grassy (four low rising sawtooths): engine note and horn now both doppler DOWN as it pulls away, over tyre grit.

The source comment says 'Payday', but Money is a playable fighter and that would be unreadable in play, so it is named for the scatter instead. Five telegraphed r:7 drops at x+(i-2)*60 for only 4+c*4 each: three coins FALLING (triangle, not square, so it leaves Lightning's and Naily's square triplets alone) over a thinning clatter. Colour moved to silver to break the three-way coin tie.

Author's name. Sweeps r+50 and sets burn 90 on everyone caught. Noise-forward by design because a fryer is mostly sizzle: the longest noise layer in the set, filter OPENING as the oil spits, over a low fwoomp and a heat-bloom both sagging.

Author's name (the comment heads it 'Gelatin — ICE BREAKER'). The code sets t.frozen=0 and t._freezeLock=0 to SHATTER first, then applyHit launches: 60ms brittle crack, then the launch sweeping up with a shard shimmer, over noise falling as the pieces scatter.

The first thing the code does is f._switchOn=true, then it hits a radius growing with charge (rng=64+c*40) with 12 lamp-yellow puffs. Sound follows that order exactly: 20ms toggle click over a hard clack, ballast surge, then a glow blooming. Surge lifted 220->280 to clear Pillow's boing.

Hits a radius-80 burst 40px ahead and stamps slowed=150 and weakened=240: the damage is incidental, the STAIN is the point and it lasts. Wet splat, noise closing hard as the ink soaks in, triangle sagging over 0.21s for the lingering slow.

Fans three bouncing coins at vx face*(9,11,13) and vy -4,-2,0 with payday:true (up to +120% vs hurt foes): a register ching answered a step higher, over bright coins clattering. Rises, where Nickel's Loose Change falls, so the two coin fighters are never confused.

Renamed from 'Thorn Reel' (echoed her own special, Thorn Lash). The lash reaches 320 and sets t.vx toward her with puffs stepping outward: a whip-crack sweeping down, then a rising tone as everything is dragged back in. Crack switched to square at 1400 to clear Pin's 1200 saw and Balloony's 1500 saw.

A retreat, not an attack: vx=-face*24 hurls him BACKWARD with 16 frames of invuln, shedding five shards that trail behind. Yelp sweeping up, squeak higher still, then a dry knock and wood clatter closing as the splinters drop. Shifted off 420/700 so it no longer shares Bubble's exact pitch pair.

Renamed from 'Triple Squeeze' (near-duplicate of Taco's Triple Splat). for(let i=0;i<3;i++) lays three stationary r=14 trap globs at +20, +60, +100 with kb 2: it extrudes a line, it does not hit anything. Three squelches each lower and quieter as the tube runs down, over one continuous wet extrusion. No transient, no launch.

The tightest radius in the game (52) with the shortest flash (8) but heavy damage (14+c*10): a savage in-your-face outburst, not a projectile. Three stuttered sawtooth syllables ending on a rising shout, over a breathy blast. The whole thing is 0.17s, matching flash=8.

Renamed from 'Aaaaa Blast' (David does not scream, he gripes: 'Aw, seriously'). cx=f.x with NO face offset, so this is the one smash that fires omnidirectionally out of him, radius 160, knockback signed away. Two sawtooth voices yelling up then breaking down, a sub for the shockwave, noise closing as the ring passes you. Sub lifted 90->100 to sit above w138 Tree.

Renamed from 'Flare Up' (too generic, and it did not separate him from his father). Point-blank hitCircle at f.r+34 with vy -9 that sets burn=100 on everyone near: ignition crack, saw sweeping UP for the flame and the launch, noise OPENING as fire catches. Both sweeps run opposite to Firey's, so father and son never blur.

healing=120 and pct reduced by 8+c*6 happen BEFORE the r:70 vine strike, so the sound restores first (a warm octave rise and shimmer) then snaps down into the leafy hit. Lifted 220->247 to clear Golf Ball's curse, which starts on the same pitch.

Instantaneous and perfectly flat: a beam from f.x to f.x+face*900 hitting only a razor-thin band (|t.y-y| < r+10) with vy of just -5. Rebuilt as a flat SNAP rather than a sweep (it was tracing the same up-then-down arc as Ice Cube): the shortest sound in the game at 0.13s, matching an instant beam. Colour moved to paper ivory, out of the blue-white cluster.

f.vx=face*16 with armor forced to 40 (he charges THROUGH hits), then a r=60 slab hit for 16+c*10 with 40 frames of hitstun, puffs at feetY: a shoulder-check made of pavement. Grinding lunge, then a huge slab impact and grit muffled to 130Hz. Sub raised 72->88 so w138 Tree keeps the floor of the game to itself.

f.vx=f.face*(13+c*5) rockets her forward with kb 10+c*5, and the puffs spawn BEHIND her at f.x-f.face*12: that is escaping air jetting out the back. Two detuned sawtooths falling are the untied-balloon squeal dropping as pressure bleeds off, noise hissing down as the air thins, low sine for the body-check.

Renamed from 'Dash Volley' (collided with Naily's Nail Volley and with Leafy's dash). Four IDENTICAL grav:false bolts on delay:i*5, evenly spaced, no dots: his special is the dot-dot-dash one, this is the heavy all-dash version. Flat square tones with freqTo === freq, because a dash is a steady key-down, the last longer and lower to close the transmission. Dropped to 165/124 to match w134. Colour moved to his own signal red, freeing the crowded gold band.

Hits for 13+c*9 and stamps defined=240 with defineStacks=3, the max markup: label-gun slap, then a triangle ratcheting UP as the price registers, and a paper scuff. Deliberately the bright, light cousin of Book's heavy Hardcover Slam. Colour moved off #ff5fae, which was 16 units from Flower's canonical pink.

dropProj sends one r:18 brown log (#5a3a1a) down onto the nearest foe at kb 12+c*5. At w138 the heaviest fighter in the game, so the 70->38 sine is the floor of the whole roster and everything else was raised to stay above it. Woody creak, falling whistle, deepest impact in the set. Colour lifted off #8a5a2a, the one entry genuinely too dark to read on a dark stage.

Renamed from 'Shard Nova' ('nova' is space-opera, not object show; 'Blast Chiller' is an appliance, which puts her alongside Fries' Deep Fryer). Bursts 10+c*4 freezing shards over a full 360 degrees (ang = a/N*PI*2, grav:false, noAim) plus 16 puffs at her centre: a crack sweeping UP as the cube splits, a bright ring DOWN as pieces fly off, a low core, noise closing as the ring travels away. Colour separated from Bubble's cyan.

The code tracks a `hit` flag: it swings a r+40 melee hitbox and, only if(hit), does f.pct=max(0,f.pct-10). She damages and heals off the same swing, so the name is the idiom for exactly that. Falling sine for the frosting-heavy slab plus a dull splat, then the payoff rising. Lifted 260->320 to clear Basketball's bounce. Colour moved from pink to frosting cream, matching the code's #f5c88a puffs.

The whole body is two statements: f._sawing=40+c*16 (Saw's multi-hit loop, ticking every 6 frames) and f.vx=f.face*(11+c*4). A sustained rolling grind, not an impact. Deliberately Saw's soft cousin: TRIANGLE harmonic instead of square and a noise that only opens to 1600 rather than 6000, so the shared _sawing mechanic reads as family without the two blurring. Raised 70->74 to stay above Tree's floor.
